sources.title: Novo scraps cardiovascular trials
sources.supports: adverse clinical evidence and concentration risk

financial_anchor.caveat: Includes about DKK8bn restructuring plus acquired-site effects; Q2 2026 adjusted OP was DKK33,389m and reported OP DKK27,061m.

ai_claim.claim: Valo collaboration expanded from 11 to up to 20 discovery programs; an AWS case study reports a chatbot available to 25,000 employees for about 2,500 nonregulated internal use cases.
ai_claim.stage: E1 for discovery; E2 supplier-reported internal chatbot deployment
ai_claim.scope: named partnership and nonregulated internal workflow
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled clinical transition, candidate success or cash evidence.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Ziltivekimab failed a late-stage outcome trial and two further studies were stopped, while pricing and Lilly competition pressure the core franchise.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Failure is clinical evidence; attribution to discovery method is unavailable.

rights_limit: Patient, partner and licensed data remain consent- and contract-bound; access does not establish pooled-training rights.
materiality_summary: 5% of FY2025 reported operating profit is DKK6.383bn annual pre-tax. Disclosures do not permit a consistent annual stage-adjusted monetary bridge.

arithmetic.inputs: FY2025 OP DKK127.658bn; AI attribution, transition, timing, partner and platform-cost inputs unknown
arithmetic.formula: annual AI-attributable stage-adjusted contribution + realized savings - annual partner/platform/validation costs >= 0.05*127.658bn
arithmetic.result: break-even >= DKK6.383bn annual pre-tax; achievement unestablished

g2_provisional: Insufficient: no controlled clinical-productivity or retained-economics evidence.
unresolved_questions: Which programs use Valo/AWS and who owns generated IP?
What matched cohort transition/time result exists?
What are full recurring, validation and milestone costs?
